黑白无常负手而立，周身萦绕着森寒的阴气，目光阴恻恻地打量着面前的老道，嘴角勾起一抹冰冷的弧度：“老道，施展怨煞染运术、扰乱阴阳秩序的，就是你？”

这下轮到老道咽唾沫了，别看他表面只有七十多岁的模样，实则已经活了近两百岁，修炼多年，自认有些本事，可面对大名鼎鼎的黑白无常，他心中那点底气瞬间荡然无存。

此刻脑海里只剩下一个念头——跑，拼尽全力逃跑！

老道也是够果决的，行事半点不拖泥带水，见状不妙，浑身陡然爆发起一阵刺目的血雾，竟直接施展了损耗根基的血遁之术。

“想跑？”黑无常范无咎见状，嘴角勾起一抹冰冷的嗤笑，语气里满是不屑，“若是让你这老东西逃了，我和老白哥俩的脸，岂不是要丢尽了？”

话音未落，范无咎猛地一挥手中的哭丧棒，一道无形的结界瞬间扩散开来，稳稳笼罩住方圆五百米的空间。

刚踏入血遁状态、正要冲破雾气逃窜的老道，硬生生撞在了无形结界上，“砰”的一声闷响，整个人被结界弹飞出去，重重摔在地上，一口鲜血喷了出来，血雾瞬间消散大半，气息也变得萎靡了不少。

可老道依旧没死心，猛地弹起，从怀里掏出一大堆乱七八糟的东西，一股脑地朝着结界砸去，但是依旧没什么卵用。

白无常谢必安负手而立，神色淡漠地看着这一切，语气平淡地开口：“老黑，别玩了，钟判还在地府等着咱们复命，别跟这老东西浪费时间了。”

范无咎点了点头，正准备上前，可就在这时，老道突然双眼赤红，发出一声凄厉的嘶吼，周身的气息陡然暴涨，紧接着，“轰隆”一声巨响，竟然直接自爆了。

剧烈的爆炸声响起，气浪席卷四周，尘土飞扬，吴姜站在不远处，彻底看傻眼了，下意识地爆了句粗口：

“靠！这老东西疯了吧？为了不去地府受刑，居然直接自爆，宁愿魂飞魄散？”

他万万没想到，这老道居然这么狠，这是宁为玉碎，不为瓦全啊......

Black and White Wuchang stood with his hands behind his back, with a cold Yin energy lingering around his body. He looked at the old Taoist in front of him with a sinister look, and a cold arc appeared at the corner of his mouth: "Old Taoist, are you the one who used the evil evil to dye luck and disrupted the order of yin and yang?"

Now it was the old Taoist's turn to swallow his saliva. Even though he looked like he was only over seventy years old, he had actually lived for nearly two hundred years. He had been practicing for many years and thought he had some abilities. However, facing the famous black and white impermanence, all the confidence in his heart disappeared in an instant.

At this moment, there is only one thought left in my mind - run, try your best to escape!

The old Taoist was also very decisive and did not act sloppily. When he saw something was not going well, a burst of dazzling blood mist suddenly erupted all over his body, and he actually directly used the blood escape technique that destroyed his foundation.

"Want to run away?" When Hei Wuchang and Fan Wujiu saw this, a cold sneer appeared at the corner of his mouth, his tone full of disdain, "If I let an old guy like you escape, wouldn't it mean that Brother Bai and I would be completely embarrassed?"

Before he finished speaking, Fan Wujiu suddenly waved the mourning stick in his hand, and an invisible barrier instantly spread out, firmly covering the space with a radius of 500 meters.

Lao Dao, who had just entered the Blood Escape state and was about to break through the mist and escape, suddenly bumped into the invisible barrier. With a muffled "bang" sound, his whole body was ejected by the barrier and fell heavily to the ground. A mouthful of blood spurted out. Most of the blood mist dissipated in an instant, and his breath became much weaker.

But the old man still didn't give up. He jumped up suddenly, took out a lot of messy things from his arms, and threw them towards the barrier, but it was still of no use.

Bai Wuchang and Xie Bian stood with their hands behind their hands, watching all this with an indifferent expression, and said in a calm tone: "Old Hei, stop playing around. Judge Zhong is still in the underworld waiting for us to return to life. Don't waste time with this old guy."

Fan Wu Jiu nodded and was about to step forward, but at this moment, the old Taoist's eyes suddenly turned red and he let out a shrill roar. The aura around him suddenly surged. Then, there was a loud "bang" and he actually self-destructed.

A violent explosion sounded, air waves swept around, and dust flew up. Wu Jiang stood not far away, completely dumbfounded, and subconsciously uttered a curse word:

"Damn! Is this old guy crazy? In order not to go to the underworld to be tortured, he actually blew himself up and would rather die?"

He never expected that this old Taoist would be so cruel. He would rather be in pieces than in ruins...
